**Items System** — Items can now be assigned to Locations, and you can add notes describing how a character connects to an item (e.g., "forged it," "stole it"). Cleaned up terminology, expanded the icon picker, and raised the item type cap from 10 to 50.

**Refreshed Book Templates** — All genre templates now ask the right questions instead of pre-filling worldbuilding for you. New Romance template with fields for emotional wounds, character arcs, and trope-based tags. RPG renamed to D&D 5e.
**Customizable Paragraph Line Spacing** — Set Tight, Normal, or Relaxed paragraph spacing in Settings → Interface & Manuscript. Applies throughout the app.

**Notebook Polish** — Image viewer zoom now has a clickable presets menu and double-click-to-fit. Folders match the list view layout in list mode. Smart folders show the correct item count right away instead of displaying zero until you open them.
**New "Advanced" Settings Page** — The hardware acceleration toggle and "Save Logs to Disk" troubleshooting tool now live in their own dedicated Advanced settings page.

**No More Accidental Text Selection** — Buttons, toolbars, and interface elements can no longer be accidentally highlighted. Text in editors, detail panels, and modals is still selectable as expected.
**Calculate Block** — You can now use a fixed number as the first input, not just the second. Useful for age calculations, time elapsed, or any formula with a constant first value.
**Find & Replace Buttons Light Up Sooner** — Replace and Replace All activate as soon as you type a search term, without needing to press Enter first.
**Editor Crash on Some Macs** — Fixed a crash that prevented opening notes, plot points, and manuscript scenes on certain macOS configurations.

**Words Written Not Counting After Edits** — Deleting text and typing a shorter replacement no longer reports zero words written. Your word count now reflects what you actually typed, in both the Manuscript and worldbuilding fields.

**Arc Page Fixes** — Fixed the character arc color picker showing the wrong color after creation, keyframe labels overlapping the arc title, losing your selected arc when switching pages, subplot collapse jumping to the wrong plot point, and nested subplot anchors not highlighting correctly.

**Notebook Fixes** — Creating a new folder now asks for a name upfront and drops you straight into it. Note and folder colors can now be removed after being set, and the color picker opens on hover. Canceling smart folder creation no longer leaves an empty folder behind. Drag-and-drop now shows a drop indicator in Cards and Large Cards view. Duplicate shortcuts can no longer be created in the same folder.

**Minipen Polish** — Fixed editors not responding to clicks below text content, toolbar content scrolling above the toolbar instead of behind it, plot point colors not inverting when selected, plot point type showing raw text instead of a dropdown, and browser-default checkboxes showing instead of Penpoint's styled ones.
**Search Dropdowns Getting Cut Off** — Assignment dropdowns for characters, chapters, locations, and arcs now always float above the panel edge so all your options are visible.
**New Entities Not Appearing Until You Leave the Page** — Creating a tag or character with Ctrl+N now refreshes the list immediately.
**Manuscript Import Numbering** — Part dividers (Part I, Part II, etc.) and title pages are no longer incorrectly tagged as numbered chapters when importing.
**Em Dash Cursor Jump** — Typing `--` in the manuscript editor no longer jumps your cursor to the beginning of the paragraph.
**Minipen Note Order** — Notes in Minipen now respect the sort order set in your full Notebook, including manual drag-and-drop positioning.
**Tutorial Appearing After Disabling Tutorials** — With tutorials disabled, none can sneak through. Disabled means disabled.

**Notebook Revamp** — The Notebook has been completely rebuilt into a full reference board. Store images alongside your notes with a built-in lightbox viewer. Add Shortcuts to jump to any character, location, or entity. Organize everything into nested folders up to five levels deep with a collapsible folder tree. The layout is resizable, and note card previews now show proper line breaks, list formatting, and @mentions.

**Draggable Relationship Map** — Drag characters around on the Relationship Map to arrange them however makes sense for your story. Positions are saved per book and remembered between sessions. Right-click to unpin, or hit "Reset Positions" to start fresh.

**Writing Timer** — A count-up stopwatch in the header bar for tracking your writing sessions. Works in both Worldbuilding and Manuscript modes. Start, pause, and reset from the clock dropdown. Auto-pauses when Flowstate is active and resumes when it ends. Optionally set it to auto-start when you open a book.
**Clock Widget** — See the current time in the header bar. Click to toggle between 12-hour and 24-hour formats, show or hide seconds, or turn it off entirely.
**Quick Mode Switch (Ctrl+M)** — Press Ctrl+M (Cmd+M on Mac) to instantly flip between Manuscript and Worldbuilding mode from anywhere.
**Outline Word Counts** — Hover over any folder, chapter, or scene in the Manuscript Outline to see its word count at a glance.
**Flowstate Focus Mode** — Flowstate now collapses both the outline sidebar and the Minipen when you start a session for a cleaner writing canvas. Both panels restore when you stop.
**Export Preview Shows Your Full Manuscript** — The export preview now renders all your scenes with accurate page counts and proper scene breaks from the moment it opens.
**Smarter Content Scanner** — The scanner now predicts whether each discovery is a Character, Location, or Item based on grammatical context, so you spend less time sorting through results.
**Simpler Backup Settings** — Set how often to back up and how many days to keep — that's it. Recent backups stay in full, older ones are thinned automatically.
**Smarter Help Guide** — The Help Guide now knows what page you're on and links you directly to the most relevant article.
**Performance on Slower Machines** — Reduced unnecessary background work for smoother typing and less visual stutter, especially on older hardware.
**Spellcheck Toggle in Manuscript Settings** — Turn spellcheck on and off directly from the Manuscript settings panel.
**Richer Community Stats** — Now tracks worldbuilding word counts, book count, export counts by format, and general time of day (same privacy rules as before).
**Manuscript Spacing & Indentation** — Reduced paragraph gaps in the editor so your prose reads more naturally. Tab now indents the entire paragraph as a block instead of only the first line.
**Traits Not Syncing With Character Sheets** — Trait changes in Settings now take effect immediately on all character sheets. Deleting a trait cleanly removes its blocks from all characters.

**Story Arc Fixes** — Fixed label overlaps, accidental text selection, missing anchor indicators on nested subplots, selection jumping, color picker mismatches in character arcs, and chapter/tag assignments silently unlinking when editing plot points.
**Text Disappearing When Clicking Buttons** — Typing into a rich text field and quickly clicking a button no longer causes text to vanish.
**Page Crashes on macOS** — Fixed a crash when navigating between pages or opening editors, especially on Apple Silicon Macs.

**Manuscript Sidebar Search** — Tags, plot points, and keyframes now appear in sidebar search results. Clicking a scene navigates to it correctly, and "Open in Worldbuilding" takes you to the right entity.
**Phantom Backups When Idle** — Backups no longer run when you haven't actually changed anything.
**More Accurate Writing Stats** — Session time properly pauses when you alt-tab or step away. Pasting no longer inflates your word count.
**Back/Forward Navigation Fixes** — Both directions now work correctly, including in the Notebook and when returning from the User Guide.
**@Mention Fixes** — Deleted arcs/plot points no longer appear in results. Copy-pasting @mentions preserves links. Enter after Escape creates a new line.
**Paragraph Breaks After @Mentions** — Editor upgrades no longer merge paragraphs around @mentions.
**Content Scanner + Nicknames** — Merging in the scanner no longer replaces nicknames, highlighting works, and ignoring names no longer blocks related words.
**Relationship Character Picker** — Clicking back to fix a pick now shows your full character list.
**Window Recovery on Disconnected Monitors** — Penpoint detects off-screen windows and moves them back to your main display.
**Manuscript Folder Reordering** — Folders now swap on contact, even with just two folders.
**Mini Penpoint Fixes** — Long notes no longer push Pin/Archive buttons into the text. Location profile pictures now show in the sidebar.
**Searchbar Ghost Results** — Deleted entities no longer linger. Clicking a plot point navigates correctly.
**Manuscript Export Preview** — Changing options no longer resets to page 1.
**Item Icon Picker on Small Screens** — The icon picker now scrolls and adapts to your screen size.

**Quick Create (Ctrl+N)** - Press Ctrl+N (or Cmd+N on Mac) from anywhere to instantly create a new Character, Item, Location, Chapter, Note, or Tag without leaving the page. Three ways to finish: **Create** keeps you where you were, **Create & Open** takes you to the new entity, and **Create + Mention** drops an @mention into whatever you were writing. In Manuscript Mode, "Create & Open" opens the entity in the Mini Penpoint sidebar so you never lose your place.

**Inline Images** - Insert pictures directly into any rich text editor — character bios, location descriptions, chapter notes, arc details, notebook entries, and your manuscript. Click the image button in the toolbar, pick a file, and it drops in with a decorative frame. Right-click any image for "Save to Disk" or "Delete Image." Images live inside your book folder and travel with your backups automatically.

**Character Nicknames & Aliases** - Give each character a nickname or alias that shows up everywhere — on cards, in chapters, on the relationship map, in the timeline, and across the compendium. Search by alias using the searchbar or @mentions, and the Content Scanner recognizes aliases when scanning your manuscript.

**Spellcheck Enabled** - Built-in OS-level spellcheck in the manuscript editor and rich text fields. Misspelled words get the familiar red underline, and right-click gives you suggestions. ProWritingAid and Grammarly desktop apps work too — no setup needed.

**Collapsible Character Blocks** - Every block on your character sheet can now be collapsed by clicking its header. Your collapse preferences are remembered separately for the Characters page and the Minipen sidebar, so you can keep different views for different workflows.

**Create New from Any Assignment Dropdown** - When assigning a relationship, location, item, or chapter, you can now create a brand new one right from the dropdown. Start typing a name that doesn't exist yet and a "Create New..." option appears — one step instead of two.

**Right-Click Menus** - Right-click any book in the Book Library for quick access to Edit, Duplicate, Export, Backup, Restore, or Delete. Right-click inside any rich text field for Cut, Copy, Paste, Insert @Mention, and Insert Image.

**Quick Add in Content Scanner** - Manually add entities directly from scanner results. Hit "Quick Add," pick the type, type the name, and it'll be created and linked to the chapter when you apply. You can also link it as an alias to an existing entity.
**Content Scanner Now Detects Tags** - The scanner now matches your Tags alongside Characters, Locations, and Items. Tag matches show up with their color so you can spot them at a glance.

**Cloud Storage Warning** - If your book is stored inside a cloud-synced folder (OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive, or iCloud), Penpoint now warns you and points you toward the safer alternative: Secondary Backups.
**Smarter Automatic Backups** - Backups now only run when you've actually made changes. No more identical backups rotating out older ones while you're away.
**Better Backup Defaults** - Backups now run every 20 minutes (was 30), keep 12 hourly snapshots (was 8), and retain 10 days of daily backups (was 30). These kick in automatically when you update.
**Export Now Includes All Pictures** - The "Include Pictures" toggle now exports profile pictures for characters, locations, *and* items, plus any images you've embedded in your writing.
**Transparent Images Stay Transparent** - Profile pictures and inline images with transparency (like character art saved as PNG) now keep their transparent backgrounds intact.
**Manuscript Export Wizard Polish** - Scene break style names are now in plain English, the preview panel is larger, chapter rows are fully clickable, and the step counter adapts to your export path.
**Spellcheck Toggle** - Turn off spellcheck underlines in Settings → Interface → Spellcheck. Handy if you write in a language your system doesn't support or use lots of invented names.
**Add Character Button Always Visible** - The "Add Character" button now lives above the character list instead of inside it — no more scrolling to the top.
**Mini Penpoint Character Names** - Character names in the sidebar were oversized at larger font sizes. Now properly scaled to fit.
**Editor Shortcuts** - Indent/Outdent shortcuts now show Tab and Shift+Tab, which work on every keyboard layout.
**Announcement Link Button** - Announcements with a link now show a copy-link button next to the action button.
**Manuscript Content Disappearing** - Fixed a rare bug where clicking above the chapter header could cause your writing to silently disappear during autosave. Multiple safety nets added.
**Going Offline No Longer Empties Your Project** - Disconnecting from the internet no longer makes the app appear completely empty until you reconnect.
**Paragraph Breaks Lost During Editor Migration** - Upgrading your book to the new editor no longer merges separate paragraphs into one block of text.
**Mini Penpoint Showing Raw Data** - Descriptions in the Mini Penpoint sidebar now display properly with all your formatting intact instead of raw code.
**Searchbar Crash on Special Characters** - Searching with smart quotes, em dashes, or other typographic characters no longer crashes the app.
**Manuscript Export Improvements** - Exports now include an optional title page, proper horizontal rules, correct paragraph spacing in DOCX/PDF, and centered text stays centered.
**Pasting Across Scene Breaks** - Copying text across a scene boundary no longer inserts horizontal lines and stray icons.
**Manuscript Remembers Your Place Per Book** - Each book now independently tracks where you left off in the manuscript.
**Clicking Tags in Edit Mode** - Tags are now clickable even while editing — click the name to jump to the Tags viewer.
**Startup Soft-Lock** - Multiple popups at startup no longer stack on top of each other.
**Restore from File on Book Selection Screen** - The "Restore from File" option now only appears when you're inside a book.
**Negative Word Counts in Community Stats** - Community stats no longer show negative word counts after deleting text.
**Searchbar Duplicate Labels** - Search results no longer show the field name twice.
**Manuscript "Scroll to End" on Short Scenes** - Short scenes no longer appear blank when "Open Page At" is set to "End."
**Manuscript Word Count & Hard Line Breaks** - Shift+Enter line breaks now correctly count as word separators.
**Content Scanner Short Word Detection** - The scanner no longer flags two-letter words as potential character names.
**Content Scanner Ellipsis False Positives** - Words after ellipses in dialogue are no longer flagged as character names.
**Dark Mode Paste Highlighting Formatted Text** - Formatted text from dark-themed editors no longer arrives highlighted.
**Back Button After Clicking Tags** - The back button now returns you where you came from instead of landing on the Tags page.
**Manual Update Not Showing Changelog** - Checking for updates now shows the full changelog instead of a generic message.

**Find & Replace in Manuscripts** - Hit Ctrl+F to search your manuscript, or Ctrl+H to open Find & Replace. Type your search, press Enter, and Penpoint highlights every match — scrolling you right to the current one. Navigate with the arrow buttons or Enter/Shift+Enter. Replace one at a time or all at once. Works at whatever scope you're viewing — a single scene, a whole chapter, or the full book. Select text before pressing Ctrl+F and it auto-searches your selection.

**Your Manuscripts in the Searchbar** - The Glorious Searchbar now searches your prose too. Find a line of dialogue, a description, a character's inner monologue — if you wrote it, the searchbar finds it. Click a manuscript result and Penpoint takes you straight to that scene, scrolls to the matching text, and highlights it. Works from anywhere in the app, and from the Mini Penpoint sidebar while you're already writing.

**@ Mention Selection Persistence** - If you use the arrow keys or mouse to highlight a result in the @ mention dropdown, that selection now sticks as you backspace or refine your search — as long as the result is still a match. No more losing your place every keystroke.

**Plain Text Import** - You can now import .txt files into your manuscript — including exports from Google Docs. Penpoint detects paragraph breaks, chapter headings, and horizontal rules automatically, so your text arrives ready to work with.

**Manuscript Toolbar Adapts to Your Window** - The formatting toolbar now intelligently adjusts as your window gets narrower. Instead of buttons piling up and becoming unusable, they tuck themselves into a "More" menu one group at a time — starting with the least-used tools. Everything stays accessible, nothing overlaps.

**Smarter Content Scanner** - The Content Scanner no longer flags common words like "castle," "shadow," or "village" when they're used as regular words in your prose. If you have a location called "Shadow Keep," the scanner will still catch "Shadow Keep" — but it won't flag every time a character steps into a shadow.

**Deleted Blocks Dialog** - The Deleted Blocks panel now shows the correct icon and name for every block type — including Relationships, Items, Locations, Chapters, and Character Arc blocks. Selecting one of these blocks also explains that your underlying data is safe and won't be lost if the block is permanently removed.

**Copy-Paste from External Editors** - Text copied from Ellipsus, VSCodium, and other dark-themed editors no longer arrives fully highlighted in yellow. Also fixed pasting from LibreOffice Writer bringing in the wrong font and ignoring your paragraph style setting.
**Manuscript Word Count** - Fixed an issue where the word count in Manuscripts was slightly off with longer texts.
**Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End Not Scrolling** - Now correctly scrolls all the way to the top or bottom of your manuscript.

**DOCX Import Fixes** - Blank lines are no longer stripped, Heading 1 and Heading 2 styles are properly recognized (including non-English versions of Word), and soft line breaks (Shift+Enter) are handled correctly.

**Word Count Tracking Accuracy** - The Activity Tracker was counting your entire manuscript's word count as "new words" every time you left manuscript mode or closed the app. Your daily word counts and writing streaks now reflect only the words you actually typed.

**@ Mentions in Arcs Showing "..."** - Using @ mentions in any Arc rich text field (plot details, arc descriptions, character state notes) would show "..." instead of the actual name in view mode. Your mentions now display correctly.

**Flowstate Timer Overlapping Toolbar** - On smaller screens, starting Flowstate would expand the timer controls right on top of your formatting buttons. The timer now drops into its own compact panel below the toolbar — click the Flowstate button to show or hide it anytime during a session.

**Blank Book Template Selector** - The template dropdown when creating a new book could appear completely empty, with no presets to choose from. Now it shows a loading state while templates are fetched, and if something goes wrong, you'll see a clear message instead of a blank dropdown.
**Text Field Cursor Jumping** - Typing in a plain-text block on the character sheet could cause your cursor to jump around, undo words you'd already typed, or skip to the middle of a word. Fixed.

**Character Edit Mode Sticking** - If you created a character and then navigated to other pages, returning to the Characters page would always reopen that character in Edit mode — even if you'd already switched to View mode. Now it stays in View mode like you'd expect.

**Content Scanner & Single-Quote Dialogue** - If you use single quotes for inner thoughts or dialogue, the scanner no longer flags common words like "With" and "As" as character names. Also fixed dropdown menus in the scanner not matching your theme on darker color schemes.

**Content Scanner Fixes** - Fixed scrolling issues, alias capitalization being lost, names merging across dialogue boundaries, italic/bold text confusing detection, and inconsistent multi-word name detection. Also added small UX touches like a pencil icon on editable names and a note about English-language optimization.
**Activity Tracker Timing** - Your "time writing" could keep ticking when you switched to another app via Task View, Mission Control, or Win+D. Now it reliably pauses the moment you leave Penpoint.

**Manuscript Outliner Fixes** - Creating a new chapter from inside a folder now keeps it in that folder instead of dumping it at the root. Folder drag handles are now visible (not hidden until hover), and dragging chapters or folders is smoother with less flickering. You can also drag a chapter to the empty space below your outline to pull it out of a folder.

**Manuscript Mode** - The biggest feature in Penpoint's history. You can now write your entire manuscript inside Penpoint — right alongside your characters, locations, arcs, and worldbuilding. No more bouncing between apps. One place for your story, start to finish. **The Writing Experience** - A clean, distraction-free writing canvas with a fixed toolbar for formatting (bold, italic, underline, highlight, headings, lists, alignment, indentation). Canvas width is adjustable — Narrow, Standard, or Wide. Smart quotes and em dashes convert automatically as you type. **Scenes & Structure** - Your chapters are made up of scenes — the building blocks of your manuscript. Split any scene in two with Ctrl+Shift+Enter, or start a new chapter with Ctrl+Shift+Alt+Enter. Delete a divider to merge scenes back together. Drag and drop scenes and chapters in the outline sidebar to restructure your story. Choose from six scene divider styles. **Chapter Groups** - Organize your chapters into groups like "Part I," "Book Two," or "Act Three." Groups are collapsible, renamable, and show up in the outline sidebar to keep long manuscripts manageable. **Outline Sidebar** - A full chapter-and-scene navigation panel on the left. Click a chapter to read the whole thing, click a scene to focus on just that piece, or click "Full Book" to see your entire manuscript. Right-click for quick actions. The sidebar is collapsible and resizable. **Flowstate for Manuscripts** - Flowstate is now built directly into the manuscript editor. Start a timed writing session (Ctrl+Shift+F), and your existing text locks behind you — you can only write forward. When the timer ends, everything unlocks for revision. **Manuscript Import** - Bring your existing work into Penpoint. Import from **.docx**, **.epub**, **.md**, and **.txt** files. Penpoint detects chapter boundaries automatically, lets you preview the structure, and choose which chapters to bring in. Formatting is preserved. **Manuscript Export** - Export your manuscript as **.docx**, **.pdf**, **.rtf**, or **.txt** — a single scene, a chapter, or the full book. Choose your scene break style for the exported file independently of how they look in the editor. **Manuscript Versions** - Save named snapshots of your entire manuscript at any point. Browse old versions in a read-only viewer. Up to 10 versions per book. **Scene Drafts** - Try a different direction for a scene without losing the original. Create multiple drafts per scene, give each a description, and restore any draft when you're ready. **Autosave** - Every change saves automatically as you type. **Arcs — Story Structure & Character Journeys** - The biggest feature yet! The brand new Arcs page gives you a visual, interactive way to map out your entire narrative. There are two modes: **Story Arcs** let you plot your main storyline and subplots as sweeping arc curves. Add keyframes to mark major beats — Inciting Incident, Midpoint, Climax, and more — and watch your plot structure take shape. Subplots nest under your main arc and anchor to parent keyframes, so you can see exactly how your secondary storylines weave through the main plot. Hover over any arc in the sidebar to create subplots, drag to reorder keyframes, and click any diamond on the curve to jump to its details. **Character Arcs** track a character's emotional fortune over time as a rising-and-falling curve. Pick from arc templates like "Hero's Journey" or "Redemption" to get started, then customize from there. You can overlay multiple characters' arcs on the same visualizer to compare their emotional trajectories side by side — perfect for spotting where one character's triumph lines up with another's downfall. **It shows up everywhere, too.** The Chapters page now features a mini arc visualizer showing which story keyframes are assigned to each chapter. And on the Character Layout page, a new Character Arc block displays a compact fortune curve right on the character sheet, with both a visual curve view and a list view. Click any keyframe to jump straight to the full Arcs page. The new Arcs system are also indexed and searchable in the Glorious Searchbar so your Plot Points and Arc details can be found with a simple search. Check out the **Help Guide** for detailed walkthroughs of Story Arcs and Character Arcs, or run the built-in tutorial from the Help menu to get a guided tour.

**Relationship Map Bubble Colors** - Community bubbles were using too-similar colors (three shades of brown in a row, really?). Now adjacent communities get visually distinct colors.

**Locations Add Button Layout Shift** - The "Add New Location" button no longer vanishes when you're creating a location. It now fades to half opacity while the entry form is visible, keeping everything in place.
**Flowstate Curly Quotes** - Fixed quote marks sometimes facing the wrong direction when starting dialogue.

**Flowstate Autoscroll** - The editor now automatically scrolls as you type, keeping your cursor comfortably visible instead of letting it disappear off the bottom of the screen. No more manual scrolling mid-sentence.
**Flowstate Cursor Alignment** - Fixed a bug where the cursor would occasionally drift below the text it was supposed to be next to.

**New Items Open in Edit Mode** - When you create a new Item, it now opens straight into Edit mode so you can start filling in details immediately. No more extra click to switch from View to Edit. Characters already did this — now Items do too.

**Cramped Dropdown Menus in Edit Mode** - When assigning relationships, items, locations, or chapters to a character, the search dropdown was squished to fit the tiny input box. "Captain William Dangerfield the Third" doesn't like being truncated. The dropdown now has room to breathe, showing full names without cutting them off mid-syllable.

**Item Links from Characters** - Clicking an item on a character's page would take you to the Items tab but show the wrong item — whatever you had open last time. Now it correctly opens the item you actually clicked.

**Flowstate Writing Mode** - Ever find yourself stuck in an endless loop of editing instead of writing? Flowstate is your escape. It's a distraction-free writing space with a twist: once you finish a sentence, it locks behind you. No going back, no second-guessing — just forward momentum. A built-in timer alternates between focused writing sprints and editing breaks, so you get the best of both worlds. When the timer runs, your words lock in; when it pauses, you're free to polish. Check out the Help Guide for the full rundown on how to use Flowstate.

**More Export Formats** - The Export Wizard now supports way more than just markdown! Export your book data to Word documents (.docx), PDFs, Rich Text (.rtf), or plain text (.txt). Perfect for sharing with editors, printing, or importing into your favorite word processor. All formats work with both single-file and multi-file export modes, and we've updated the export status bar to let you know what the exact progress is of your export.

**Quick Page Navigation** - Jump to any page instantly with Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+9 (Cmd on Mac). Characters is 1, Items is 2, all the way to Compendium at 9. No more clicking through the sidebar when you're in the zone — just hit a number and you're there. These shortcuts work with your back/forward navigation too, so you can always retrace your steps.

**Reset Demo Book** - Made a mess of the Sherlock Holmes demo while exploring? You can now reset it to its original state from the book selector's options menu (the three dots). Your renamed or duplicated copies of the demo stay safe — only the original gets refreshed with the latest content.

**Keyboard Shortcuts Reference** - Ever wonder what Ctrl+E does? Now you can find out! Click the Help icon (?) in the top-right corner and select "Keyboard Shortcuts" to see every shortcut in Penpoint, organized by category. The modal automatically shows the right keys for your system — ⌘ for Mac users, Ctrl for everyone else.

**@Mentions in Exports** - When you export your book to markdown, @mentions are now converted to readable names instead of cryptic links. The export preview now includes a friendly note letting you know this will happen.

**Glorious Searchbar Fixes** - Implemented a smarter search algorithm that can handle most English morphological variations (plurals, verb tenses, -ing/-ed/-tion suffixes) so now you can more intuitively search through your book.
**Better Color Pallette** - Fixed many of the color themes to have more aesthetically pleasing colors that better fit the theme (and your eyeballs)

**Notebook Card Font Sizes** - In the notebook, individual notes when in their small 'card' format used font sizes that made everything overwhelming. We're now using smaller, more preview-like fonts that play nice with each other.

**Book Names Now Expanded** - Before you couldn't put in symbols like " - : ; and more into your books. Now you can. So you can finally write that book, Cat Burger II: "Even Burgier". And if you write a symobol we don't allow, Penpoint will now alert you instead of failing silently in the background.

**Note Title Length Limits** - Note titles now have a 50 character limit to match other entity names. This prevents export hiccups where overly long titles could cause filesystem issues. Your novel-length note titles will be gently trimmed during export.

**@Mentions in Notebook Cards** - Note preview cards were showing raw gobbledygook like `[@](cm://character/abc123)` instead of actual character names. Now @mentions display properly as bold text with the real name, making your note previews actually readable.

**"Untitled" Notes in Export** - The export wizard was showing some notes as "(Untitled)" even when they clearly had content. If your note doesn't have a title, we now use the first line of content as the label — just like the notebook cards do.

**@Mentions in Multiple Text Fields** - If you had multiple rich text boxes on the same page (like Bio and Notes on a character), @mentions would only work in the first one. Now they work everywhere, so @mention away.
**Clicking Note @Mentions** - Clicking an @mention link to a note in view mode would show "Unable to navigate to note" instead of actually opening the note. Fixed!
**Export Spacing** - Exported markdown files had missing line breaks between certain fields, making the output harder to read. We've tidied up the formatting so everything breathes a little better.

**Back Button Loop When Following Links** - Clicking a link (like a note reference from a character page) and then using the back button would get you stuck in an endless loop of opening and closing the same note. Now the back button takes you back where you came from, as it should.
**Relationship Map Intro Animation** - We were doing too much precomputing during the intro animation. We've trimmed things up a bit so it should be silky smooth.
**Relationship Map importance filter** - Character importance now filters correctly
**Timeline Bugfix** - Fixed an issue in the timeline where applying certain filters would remove the timeline interface entirely (whoops!)
**Access searchbar when editing text** - The Glorious Searchbar can now be used when editing in the Rich Text boxes instead of inserting hyperlinks. Search while editing, nice!
**Fixed book color choices** - Books would fail to be created if you picked certain colors. That's silly, so we fixed it.

**Fixed issues with duplicating books** - Fixed issues where duplicating books weren't always appearing in the book selector screen. Also, we don't know why you would want to do it, but you can now duplicate the Adventures of Sherlock Holmes demo book without it failing. This one is for you, Sir Arthur.
**Export from Book Selector** - Export any book to markdown directly from the book selection screen without opening it; right-click a book and select "Export" to launch the export wizard

**Relationship Map Overhaul** - Completely revamped the relationship map with smarter community detection that groups closely connected characters together, new sort options (by name, importance, or connection count), improved filter dropdowns that no longer cause layout shifts, and significantly faster rendering performance when navigating between characters

**Smarter Phrase Search** - The Glorious Searchbar now understands when you're searching for phrases! Multi-word searches like "devoted to his wife" find exact phrase matches first, showing you the precise context where those words appear together rather than scattered occurrences

**Progressive Search Highlighting** - Search results now highlight your query as you type, growing the highlight as you complete words; feels like the search is reading your mind and already knows what you're looking for
**Accurate Search Snippets** - Search result snippets now always show content from the field where your match was actually found; no more seeing a "Notes" label but Bio content in the preview
**Faster startup** - Optimized announcement system to prevent duplicate server requests during app launch
**Smoother Relationship Map loading** - Eliminated stuttering during the initial animation when first opening the Relationship Map

**Faster text editing** - Eliminated typing lag when editing characters, locations, or chapters with lots of content; search index updates now happen in the background instead of blocking each keystroke
**Trait option deletion** - Fixed bug where deleting trait options in Traits Manager would show success message but options would remain; options now properly delete from the database
**Search with punctuation** - Fixed search errors when queries contain periods, commas, or other punctuation; searching for "Dr. Watson" or "Holmes, Sherlock" now works correctly
**Search result stability** - Fixed visual flickering in search results when typing; results no longer jump or resize as you add spaces between words

**Book selector state on refresh** - Fixed issue where refreshing or restarting the app after returning to the book selector would incorrectly reopen the last book; app now correctly stays on the book selector when that was your last location

**Chapter details live updates** - Fixed issue where adding or removing characters, locations, items, or POV selections in chapter edit mode wouldn't show in the UI until page refresh; changes now appear immediately
**Announcements bell dropdown** - "View All Announcements" button now correctly navigates to Settings → Announcements
**Announcements cache handling** - Fixed error that could occur on startup if the local announcements cache was empty or corrupted
**Note search results** - Clicking on a note in search results now navigates directly to that note instead of just opening the Notebook page

**Help & User Guide** - New Help menu in the top-right corner provides access to 25+ tutorial articles covering every feature in Penpoint; includes visual demos, hierarchical navigation, full-text search, and clickable links that take you directly to relevant pages and settings

**Sticky Paragraph Text Box Toolbars** - Rich text toolbars now stay visible while scrolling through long character bios, location descriptions, and other text fields in edit mode, making formatting options always accessible without scrolling back to the top

**Chapter reorder controls** - Changed chapter number controls from up/down arrows to left/right arrows (← →) that match the Previous/Next chapter navigation pattern; left arrow moves to earlier chapter, right arrow moves to later chapter, making reordering more intuitive
**Timeline zoom animation** - Smooth, fluid zoom transitions with bell-curve easing; eliminated stuttering and background element lag when zooming in/out on the timeline
**Timeline text colors** - Character names in timeline bars now use consistent color scheme matching dropdown menus for better visual harmony

**Smoother Navigation Sidebar** - Sidebar now smoothly expands and collapses with animations; content area gracefully shifts to make room when pinning/unpinning; faster, more responsive collapse timing when mouse leaves
**Windows installer persistence** - Fixed issue where Penpoint would disappear from Windows Start Menu and "Apps & Features" after restarting your computer; app now properly persists across reboots
**Chapter reordering** - Fixed chapter numbers not updating in real-time when using the reorder buttons; chapter position now updates immediately in the UI without requiring a page refresh
Fixed formatting issue that could sometimes appear in rich text boxes
Fixed keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+0/1/2/3) for heading styles now preserve highlighted text instead of deleting it
Fixed Ctrl+V paste creating hyperlinks instead of pasting text when text is selected in rich text fields
Fixed page scrolling back to top when creating new items in character sheets; you now stay at the Items section after adding an item
Hyperlinks now always show underlines for better visibility in both view and edit modes
Removed brief flash of "Loading chapter..." and "Chapter not found" messages when opening chapters from the grid
Optimized layouts between view and edit mode for smoother transitions

**Smooth Page Transitions** - Pages now transition smoothly when navigating between Characters, Items, Locations, Chapters, and Notes, with content fully loaded before fading in. Extra flair for Notes that will zoom in and out when clicked!

**Relationship Map Customization** - Personalize your relationship map with adjustable line arc strength, toggleable labels, and three color saturation modes (Grayscale, Normal, Full); includes improved hover behavior in the detail panel
**Items View Modes** - Choose between Cards (multi-column grid), Compact (dense list), or Standard (comfortable list) layouts via the Settings gear icon; view preference persists across sessions
**Global Create Shortcut (Ctrl+N)** - Quickly create new items on any page with Ctrl+N (Cmd+N on Mac)
**What's New Button** - Review the complete changelog for your current version anytime from Settings → About
**Smooth Theme Transitions** - Theme colors now fade smoothly when switching themes
**Enhanced Tag Color Palette** - Expanded from 8 to 12 colors with 50%+ increased saturation for better visual distinction
**Locations expand/collapse animations** - Added Expand All / Collapse All button with smooth slide animations
**Detail panel improvements** - Consistent Edit/View toggles, removed redundant close buttons, improved Items panel space (63%/37% split)
**"Add New" buttons** - Now appear as first list item for easier access without scrolling
Character creation defaults to the importance of your most recently created character
Reduced debug logging verbosity in production logs
**Multiple blank lines in rich text** - Blank lines are now preserved in all rich text fields (bios, descriptions, notes, chapter details)
**@ mention system** - Fixed search failures, insertion issues, dropdown positioning (now sits directly above cursor and scales with font size), clipping in modals, and Esc key behavior
**Back button navigation** - Fixed back button skipping over "empty" page states (all tags, all locations, all items)
Fixed trait block dropdowns (like Alignment) causing page to jump and lose scroll position
Fixed book ID mismatch warning when importing backup files (.penpoint)
Fixed chapter numbers not updating after adding/deleting chapters
Fixed Ctrl+E shortcut not working on Items and Locations pages
Fixed Locations dropdown in character sheets not allowing typing
Fixed location descriptions not updating when switching in edit mode
Fixed checkbox checkmarks not adapting to theme colors
Fixed items jumping without animation when changing sort/filters
Fixed searchbar shifting horizontally between pages
Fixed dual column layout pushing add form to the right when empty
Improved page transition performance
**Page Transitions** - Navigation between pages now features smooth crossfade transitions for a more polished, app-like feel:

subBullets.text: When switching between pages, the current page fades out while the new page fades in simultaneously
Pages wait until fully loaded before transitioning, so you never see half-rendered content or loading spinners
Data cascade animations (like character lists fading in row-by-row) only play once per page load, preventing jarring re-animations during navigation
Transitions are fast (400ms) and subtle, prioritizing usability over flashiness
Works seamlessly with browser back/forward buttons and all navigation methods
The old page stays static during the transition to prevent distracting refreshes or content shifts

entries.text: **Global Settings from Book Selector** - Settings are now accessible from the book selection screen via a gear icon in the top-right corner; access Interface, Announcements, Advanced, and About settings without opening a book

**Restore Backup from Book Selector** - Restore .penpoint backup files directly from the book selection screen without creating a placeholder book first; restored books are automatically named with "(Recovered)" suffix to avoid conflicts

**Customizable Text Line Height** - New setting in Settings → Interface to adjust line spacing from Single (1.0) to Double (2.0); applies globally to all text including rich text fields and block list items (relationships, items, locations, chapters); defaults to Normal (1.15) for comfortable reading

**Interactive Relationship Map** - Explore your character relationships in a stunning new visual format! Access the Relationship Map from the navigation sidebar to see all your character connections come to life:

subBullets.text: Characters appear as interactive cards positioned by importance: highly connected characters cluster near the center, while isolated characters appear at the edges
Smooth animated entrance on first load: character cards emerge from the center and float to their positions with elegant staggered timing
Click any character to focus on them: the camera smoothly zooms and pans to center their relationship network, fading out unrelated characters for clarity
Relationship detail panel slides in from the right, showing all of the selected character's connections with directional arrows (outgoing →, incoming ←, or bidirectional ↔)
Navigate between characters by clicking names in the detail panel - the map smoothly transitions to show each new character's network
Hover over any character or relationship line to highlight it with smooth color transitions
Bidirectional relationships display as two gracefully curved arrows, each with its own relationship label
Relationship lines use color gradients that blend between the connected characters' theme colors
Filter your view by relationship direction (outgoing, incoming, reciprocal), specific character, or character importance level
Pan and zoom freely to explore your entire relationship web, or click the background to deselect and return to the full view
Perfect for writers managing complex character dynamics across large casts or series with interconnected storylines

entries.text: **Faster Update Rollouts** - Penpoint now checks for updates on every app launch (instead of once per day) and continues checking every 12 hours while running. Added "Automatic Update Checking" toggle in Settings → About for users who prefer to stay offline.

**Reduced Log File Size** - Significantly reduced logging verbosity by removing repetitive autosave success logs and consolidating navigation logs; log files are now ~85-90% smaller while retaining all important error and diagnostic information

**Nested bullet point duplication** - Fixed bug where nested bullet points in rich text fields (like character skills or traits) would duplicate in view mode, showing child items multiple times under parent entries; nested lists now render correctly with each item appearing only once
**Tag color updates** - Fixed issue where changing tag colors after creation would fail silently with "Failed to update tag" error; tags can now be successfully updated with new colors and names
**Glorious Searchbar modal height** - Fixed modal search (Ctrl+K) expanding to fill the screen when displaying results; modal now maintains a fixed height and uses scrolling for overflow results

**Glorious Searchbar fullscreen transition** - Fixed visual overlap when clicking the fullscreen button in the navbar search; inline dropdown now closes smoothly before the modal opens, and your search text carries over automatically

**Dynamic @ Mention Links** - @ mentions are now truly dynamic! When you rename a character, location, item, or chapter, all @ mention links to that entity automatically update throughout your book to show the new name:

subBullets.text: Previously, @ mentions captured the name at the time you created the link, so renaming "Sherlock Holmes" to "Enola Holmes" wouldn't update existing mentions
Now, @ mentions always display the current name of whatever you're linking to, making it safe to rename entities without worrying about outdated references
Works everywhere: character bios, location descriptions, item notes, chapter details, and all rich text fields
Your existing @ mentions continue to work exactly as before - this enhancement is fully backward compatible
Perfect for writers who evolve character names or locations as their story develops

entries.text: **Interface Settings Redesign** - Simplified the Settings → Interface page for a cleaner, more focused experience:

subBullets.text: Removed the busy "Live Preview" section that took up too much space
Reorganized all settings into a clean two-column layout
Left column groups appearance settings: Color Theme, Typography, and Font Size
Right column groups behavior settings: Animation Style and Startup Behavior
Settings are now easier to find and less overwhelming to navigate

entries.text: **Settings Navigation** - Increased the width of the settings category list by 35% to reduce text wrapping and improve readability

**Critical Database Migration Fix** - Fixed database migration issue that prevented books from opening after upgrading from v1.0.3 to v1.0.4; affected databases are automatically detected and repaired when opening a book, with no data loss

**Chapter grid layout** - Fixed inconsistent card heights in chapter grid where alternate rows appeared smaller than others; all chapter cards now maintain uniform size across all rows using consistent grid row heights
**Smart Quotes (Curly Quotes)** - Penpoint now automatically converts straight quotes to proper typographic quotes as you type, giving your writing a professional, published look:

subBullets.text: Straight double quotes (") become opening (") or closing (") curly quotes based on context
Straight apostrophes (') become opening (') or closing (') curly quotes
Apostrophes in contractions (like "don't" or "it's") automatically use the correct closing quote
Works everywhere: character names, location names, item names, chapter titles, text fields, notes, and all rich text areas
Smart enough to know when to use opening vs. closing quotes based on what comes before (after spaces, punctuation, or at the start of text)
Cross-platform support: works identically on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Example: typing `"Sherlock's room"` automatically becomes `"Sherlock's room"`

entries.text: **Insert New Chapter** - You can now insert chapters anywhere in your story! When viewing a chapter, click the "Insert New Chapter" button to choose whether to insert before or after the current chapter; all subsequent chapters automatically renumber themselves to make room for the new chapter

**New Export & Import Wizard** - A brand new page in settings/import & export will walk you through exporting all your Penpoint book data to markdown format and back again. Perfect for processing with LLM tools or for exporting to a word processor!

**Template Generation Wizard** - The "Generate Templates" button in Import/Export now opens a step-by-step wizard similar to the Export feature, letting you choose exactly which template types you want (Characters, Locations, Items, Notes, or Chapters) instead of always generating all five; templates are saved as individual markdown files in a templates/ folder for easier organization and use with AI tools

**Settings navigation toggle** - Fixed issue where clicking the Settings button while already in a settings subcategory (like Traits Manager or Character Layout) wouldn't take you back to the settings home page; now clicking Settings again properly returns you to the settings overview where you can choose a different category

**Glorious Searchbar modal (Ctrl+K)** - Fixed critical bug where the fullscreen search modal wouldn't respond to typing or clicking on results; modal search now works identically to the inline navbar search, with full keyboard navigation support (arrow keys, Enter to select) and proper result expansion to fill available vertical space; modal mode now shows up to 100 results (up from 50) to take advantage of the larger display area

**Chapter navigation animations** - Fixed jarring chapter transition animations where content would update too early; when navigating between chapters using arrow keys or clicking next/previous, the current chapter now smoothly slides out completely before the new chapter slides in, preventing the disorienting flash where new content appeared mid-animation; this applies to chapter titles, descriptions, chapter details, author notes, and all assignments (characters, locations, items)
**Tags Viewer Page** - New dedicated Tags page accessible from the navigation sidebar that lets you explore your entire book through the lens of your tags:

subBullets.text: Browse all your tags in one place with three sorting options: by usage count (most-used first), alphabetically, or by date created
Click any tag to instantly see every character, item, location, chapter, and note that uses that tag, all organized in expandable sections
Filter results by entity type using the "Show:" buttons - quickly focus on just characters, just locations, or any combination you need
Each result shows a snippet of content (biography, description, or note preview) to help you understand the context at a glance
Click any result to jump directly to that character, item, location, chapter, or note for quick navigation across your book
Collapse and expand sections (Characters, Items, etc.) with smooth animations to focus on what matters
Your selected tag and view state persist across sessions - return to exactly where you left off, even after closing and reopening the app
Use browser back/forward buttons to navigate between different tag selections
Perfect for finding all characters with the "Antagonist" tag, all locations marked "Urban", or all chapters tagged "Climax"

entries.text: **Tag display redesign** - Completely refreshed tag displays across all entity types (Characters, Items, Locations, Chapters, and Notes) with a cleaner, more unified look:

subBullets.text: Tags now display with thin borders and small colored squares instead of filled backgrounds, making them easier to scan at a glance
In edit mode, "Selected Tags:" and "Available Tags:" labels clearly distinguish between assigned and unassigned tags
Available tags now show usage counts (e.g., "Dangerous 30", "London 25") to help you understand how frequently each tag is used across your book
Sorting method selector moved to the right side for better visual separation
Consistent styling across all pages ensures tags look and behave the same everywhere

entries.text: **Announcement animations** - Added smooth cascading fade-in animations to announcement overlays with clean transitions between multiple announcements

**Tag notifications** - Tag creation and deletion notifications now appear centered at the top of the tag list instead of in the bottom-right corner, making them much easier to see; notifications fade in and out smoothly for a polished feel

**Locations "Add New Location" button** - Added ghost card style "+ Add New Location" button at the bottom of the locations hierarchy list; clicking the button now shows the creation input at the bottom (where you clicked) instead of at the top, and new locations are created at the bottom of the root level for better visibility
**Number field click target** - Added underline to number input fields in edit mode to make it clearer where to click to enter values

**Character selection persistence** - Fixed issue where the app wouldn't remember which character you had selected when refreshing or reopening; now properly restores your selected character just like it does for items, locations, and chapters
**Tag deletion** - Fixed bug where attempting to delete tags would fail with an error message; tags can now be deleted successfully whether deleting one tag at a time or multiple tags in bulk

**Tag dialog text overflow** - Fixed tag deletion and merge confirmation dialogs to properly display all text when using larger font sizes; dialog boxes now expand to fit content instead of cutting off text or buttons

**Rich text zoom support in edit mode** - Fixed issue where zooming in and out (using Ctrl+Plus/Ctrl+Minus or the font size controls in Settings) would not affect text size while editing rich text fields like character biographies, location descriptions, or item notes; text now properly scales in both View and Edit modes, making it easier to read and write at your preferred size

**Search bar responsiveness** - Fixed search bar to shrink responsively with smaller window sizes instead of maintaining fixed width and overlapping with page titles and header elements; search bar now uses flexbox layout to naturally adapt to available space while maintaining its centered position

**Loading screen transitions** - Fixed jarring content pop-in when refreshing or opening books; loading screen now intelligently pre-fetches page-specific data (locations, chapters, items, etc.) based on your last visited page, ensuring smooth fade-out transitions with content already loaded and ready to display

**Hyperlinks in Rich Text Editor** - Insert hyperlinks in character/location/item/chapter details and notes using the link button in the toolbar; links open in your default external browser and display a hover preview in view mode showing the URL with a copy-to-clipboard button

**Location hierarchy UI** - Add button (+) now appears closer to location names instead of far to the right; new location input now visually aligns with where the child location will appear in the hierarchy

**Locations character/item assignment** - Unified the "Add Characters or Items" search in Location detail panels to use the same autocomplete dropup component as other blocks, providing consistent keyboard navigation and filtering behavior

**Spell-checking disabled** - Browser spell-check has been disabled across all text inputs to prevent red underlines on fantasy names, fictional locations, and custom jargon; a more writer-friendly solution may be added in the future

**Book grid layout** - Improved book card spacing on wide screens; when displaying one or two books, cards now group together naturally instead of stretching across the full screen width with awkward gaps
**Search system overhaul** - Completely rebuilt the search indexing and query system to ensure reliable, accurate search results:

subBullets.text: **Special character handling**: Fixed FTS5 syntax errors when searching with apostrophes, semicolons, and other special characters (e.g., "The Mayor's Estate" no longer causes search errors); search now uses hybrid sanitization that removes problematic operators while maintaining natural word-level matching

**Search index maintenance**: Search index now automatically stays synchronized with database changes; all entity create/update/delete operations immediately update the search index, ensuring newly created characters, locations, items, chapters, and notes are instantly searchable

**Smart index verification**: On book open, the system verifies search index integrity by comparing entity counts and automatically rebuilds if mismatches are detected, ensuring search results are always complete and accurate

**Ctrl+K modal improvements**: Fixed modal search (opened with Ctrl+K) to start with fresh, empty state on each open, auto-focus the search input for immediate typing, and automatically close after selecting a result
**Comprehensive logging**: Added detailed backend logging for search queries, sanitization, results, index verification, and rebuild operations to aid in debugging

entries.text: **Tag color mismatch** - Fixed critical bug where selected tag colors didn't match what was stored in the database; tags now store color IDs (1-8) instead of theme-specific hex values, ensuring selected colors are accurately represented and automatically adapt when switching themes (affects all tag displays across Characters, Items, Locations, Chapters, and Notes pages)

**Ctrl+E toggle reliability** - Fixed issues where Ctrl+E would not properly toggle between View and Edit modes across all pages (Characters, Items, Locations, and Chapters); event listeners now use stable ID dependencies instead of object references, preventing missed keypresses during data refetches

**Multi-filter query bug** - Fixed Chapters and Items filtering to correctly handle multiple filter types simultaneously (e.g., filtering chapters by both POV character and location now returns only chapters matching both criteria, instead of showing "No results found")

**Chapter details persistence in edit mode** - Fixed issue where Chapter Details rich text content would persist from previous chapter when navigating between chapters in edit mode; content now correctly updates immediately when switching chapters

**Chapter details content duplication** - Fixed race condition where Chapter Details content could be duplicated or corrupted when switching between view and edit modes or when navigating between chapters; added synchronization guards to prevent autosave from triggering during content updates

**Pinnable Navigation Sidebar** - Click the pin icon in the top-right corner to lock the sidebar in its expanded state, keeping all navigation labels visible and shifting content to accommodate the wider sidebar (pin state persists across sessions)
**Global Edit Mode Toggle** - Press Ctrl+E (Cmd+E on Mac) to quickly toggle between View and Edit modes when viewing Characters, Items, Locations, or Chapters
**Chapter Edit Mode Visual Indicator** - Chapters now display a dashed border outline and dimmed paper background when in Edit mode, matching the visual style of other detail panels

**Glorious Searchbar** - Universal search with inline and fullscreen modes, search history (max 10 items with removable entries), smart suggestions, and one-click navigation to characters, locations, items, chapters, and notes

**Fuzzy Search** - Search now tolerates typos and misspellings (e.g., "Shrlock" finds "Sherlock", "Watsen" finds "Watson") with transparent fallback that activates only when exact matches aren't found
**Search Dismissal** - Click outside the search dropdown or press Esc to close it; Esc key now prioritizes closing search over back navigation when search is open
**Character Name Length Limit** - Character names now limited to 45 characters with visual counter that appears when exceeding 25 characters, preventing performance issues with very long names
**Window State Persistence** - App now launches maximized by default and remembers your preferred window size and position across sessions
Increased width of Items detail sidebar from 480px to 600px to prevent content truncation
Removed "tag updated" toast notifications for cleaner tag editing experience
Searchbar now centers to page width instead of container for better visual alignment
Increased modal searchbar width from 896px to 1024px for improved readability

**Improved search ranking** - Character names now heavily prioritized in search results, with entity type boosting (characters > locations > items > notes) and exact title match bonuses for more relevant results

**Navigation sidebar enhancements** - Added subtle horizontal divider between logo and menu items, improved logo/text spacing with consistent vertical alignment across all states, and added 750ms collapse delay when mouse leaves unpinned navbar for smoother interaction
"Tags Manager" text in tag creation prompts is now a clickable link that navigates directly to Settings > Tags
**Locations detail panel layout** - Aligned spacing, font sizes, and styling with Items panel for consistent, tighter visual presentation across detail pages
Rich text editor toolbar elements now properly adapt colors when switching between light and dark themes
Tag color picker now correctly displays theme-appropriate colors in preview
Removed misleading color tooltips that didn't match current theme
Fixed search navigation bug where clicking search results required two clicks to navigate correctly
Items detail panel now correctly displays "Delete Item" instead of "Delete Prop" in edit mode
Fixed "Single Owner Only" filter in Items page - unchecking the checkbox now properly clears the filter instead of inverting it
Timeline view now properly refreshes data when navigating to it, ensuring recently added character-chapter assignments appear immediately without requiring app restart
**Item deletion performance** - Fixed 30-second freeze when deleting items by manually cleaning up timeline positions before cascading deletes; delete operation now completes in milliseconds
**Delete confirmation dialog** - Fixed bug where item name didn't appear in "Delete permanently?" confirmation message, now correctly displays the item name

**Relationships block character creation** - Added "Add New Character" option to relationship creation dropdown, opening the standard Add Character dialog for seamless character creation while adding relationships

**NumberBlock increment/decrement** - Fixed race condition where number values would jump back to previous values when using arrow keys; optimistic cache updates now prevent CalculateBlock refetches from overwriting user input
**CalculateBlock divide-by-zero** - Fixed bug where setting fixed number to 0 would reset to 1 when switching input types; zero values now properly preserved and division by zero correctly shows N/A

**Items Archetype filter** - Fixed bug where archetype checkboxes didn't properly filter items; checkbox state now syncs correctly with filter state, allowing users to check/uncheck archetypes to narrow down items

versions.intro: Initial beta release for early testers.

entries.text: **Auto-updater** with announcement management system
**Multi-book support** with book selection and management
**Universal search** with full-text search (FTS5) across all content
**Character tracking** with importance levels and customizable properties
**Locations system** with drag-and-drop organization and timeline views
